prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 close-up smartphone portrait from an approved-adult face reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult subject whose facial identity, structure, and likeness are preserved from the required reference, with fair rosy skin, curtain bangs, soft mermaid waves, pink ribbon, rosy blush, glossy pink lips, pink beaded necklaces, and pearl-gold earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Head-and-shoulders close-up, direct gentle smile and eye contact, dark minimalist indoor background kept fully sharp, crisp accessory detail, no bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm natural window daylight with soft highlight rolloff and gentle blush reflection, luminous but realistic skin with visible pores and no plastic smoothing.
prompt.technical_specs: Google Pixel 8-style smartphone photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, entire frame sharp, minimal HDR flattening, realistic digital clarity and color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Use the exact approved-adult facial identity from the attached reference with zero alteration to facial structure or likeness. Create a hyper-realistic 4:5 head-and-shoulders portrait with a gentle smile and direct eye contact. The subject has fair rosy skin with realistic pores, soft curtain bangs, soft mermaid waves, wispy damp-looking strands, a delicate pink ribbon near the ear, rosy pink blush, glossy pink lips, defined lashes, subtle winged liner, shimmering eyeshadow, multi-layered pink beaded necklaces with heart and bow charms, and pearl-gold stud earrings. Use a dark minimalist indoor background kept fully sharp, warm natural window daylight, soft highlight rolloff, true-to-life vibrant colors, Google Pixel 8-style digital clarity, and luminous but natural skin.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, altered face, identity drift, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult face reference.
